stem: In Q2 Voltmarkt's TV category had €420,000 of regular-price revenue, €140,000 of promotion revenue and €40,000 of markdown revenue. In Q3 it had €330,000 regular, €140,000 promotion and €30,000 markdown. Promo share of sales divides promotion revenue by the category's total net revenue from all lines. By how many percentage points did the TV promo share of sales rise from Q2 to Q3? Give the answer in percentage points with 1 decimal.
